Details
  • Paper: EfficientViT-SAM: Accelerated Segment Anything Model Without Accuracy Loss, CVPR 2024 Workshop (Efficient Large Vision Models), 2024-02-07
  • Original code: https://github.com/mit-han-lab/efficientvit at de7d7733cc03
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-segment-anything
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/mit-han-lab/efficientvit-sam/blob/a2f0c5929196a13ef1ffc9338d3f9e482e1e0e68/README.md (license: apache-2.0, with LICENSE.txt); code: https://github.com/mit-han-lab/efficientvit/blob/de7d7733cc0329f391b33f1f459271562ec27bd5/LICENSE
  • Training data: distilled from SAM ViT-H, then trained on SA-1B (11M licensed images, 1.1B automatically generated masks) per the paper; the dataset itself is under the SA-1B research licence
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: efficientvit-sam-l0, efficientvit-sam-l1, efficientvit-sam-l2, efficientvit-sam-xl0, efficientvit-sam-xl1
  • Outputs: pred_masks, iou_scores
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized inside to the fixed encoder input 1024x1024 (the default export size)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): efficientvit-sam-l0 1080x1920 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.2 reserved); efficientvit-sam-l1 1080x1920 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.2 reserved); efficientvit-sam-l2 1080x1920 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved); efficientvit-sam-xl0 1080x1920 (0.4 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); efficientvit-sam-xl1 1080x1920 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved)
  • efficientvit-sam-l0 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 25 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp32 20 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientvit-sam-l1 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 25 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp32 22 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientvit-sam-l2 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 26 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp32 24 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientvit-sam-xl0 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 24 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp32 30 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientvit-sam-xl1 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 27 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp32 37 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientvit-sam-l0 original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l0 original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l1 original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l1 original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l2 original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l2 original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-xl0 original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-xl0 original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-xl1 original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-xl1 original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream EfficientViTSamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)
  • efficientvit-sam-l0 load / first call: original 0.35 s / 0.817 s, portable 0.83 s / 0.723 s, kernels 1.63 s / 0.253 s
  • efficientvit-sam-l1 load / first call: original 0.31 s / 0.032 s, portable 0.76 s / 0.694 s, kernels 1.64 s / 0.254 s
  • efficientvit-sam-l2 load / first call: original 0.39 s / 0.037 s, portable 0.93 s / 0.658 s, kernels 1.78 s / 0.248 s
  • efficientvit-sam-xl0 load / first call: original 0.62 s / 0.592 s, portable 2.67 s / 0.519 s, kernels 2.14 s / 0.259 s
  • efficientvit-sam-xl1 load / first call: original 1.06 s / 0.041 s, portable 2.32 s / 0.534 s, kernels 2.51 s / 0.238 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

One point per ground-truth instance (the interior point farthest from the border); IoU of the best-scored of 3 masks / of the single mask. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 2.5 % and p99 <= 7.3 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output pred_masks).
